question: Do first weekly 1618 touches within +-2h of scheduled US CPI, payrolls or FOMC releases break more often?
events: inputs/bls_release_dates.json (BLS archive filenames, 08:30 ET) and inputs/fomc*.htm (federalreserve.gov, scheduled decision day 14:00 ET; unscheduled, cancelled and notation votes excluded).
success_criterion: Per primary: news-window validity below other touches, one-sided within-week permutation Holm p<0.01, and news-window validity below 38.2 percent.
limitations: Event times are scheduled times; 2011-2012 FOMC statement times varied (12:30/14:15 ET). Unscheduled events and other releases (PPI, retail sales, PCE) not included.
